title: Beyond Memorization: A Multi-Modal Ordinal Regression Benchmark to Expose Popularity Bias in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Stratifying building age estimation performance (Interval Accuracy) based on Wikipedia page-view counts, used as a proxy for building popularity, and calculating the performance gap (Gain) between highly popular landmarks and low-popularity buildings.
Evaluating and comparing the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of model predictions across five different continents (Africa, Americas, Asia, Australia, Europe) to expose regional performance disparities.

Comparing Mean Absolute Error (MAE) across eight distinct historical construction periods spanning from 1000 to 2024 CE to identify performance degradation on older, less represented architecture compared to modern buildings.
